newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: MALAYSIA STOCKS - factors to watch - June 10.
newsitem.headline: MALAYSIA STOCKS - factors to watch - June 10.

text.p: Following are some of the main factors likely to affect Malaysian stocks on Tuesday:
* On Monday, the Dow Jones Industrial Average rose 42.72 points or 0.57 percent to close at 7478.50.
* The Kuala Lumpur Composite Index was off 0.11 to 1,117.20.
* Ringgit quoted at 2.5088/98 a dollar at around 0050 GMT, a little firmer from its Kuala Lumpur ending on Monday at 2.5108/18.
